title: SRD: Help assists the ability check of one ally, and an enemy isn't one; engine: help_check gives Advantage to any creature named, including an enemy

history.summary: help_check now refuses any target that game.is_ally doesn't count as the helper's ally (an enemy, for example). The refusal carries page=176 and rule=GLOSS.ally#3. It runs after the R-36 self-check and before the proficiency checks, so nothing is spent and no effect is added. It reuses is_ally (party, team, friendly attitude, GM team designation) rather than adding a second ally test. The ticket test passes with --runxfail. In the normal run its only failure is the strict XPASS, which goes away when the harness removes the marker. Unit tests: 543 passed. Acceptance suites otherwise green. dev-gate: PASS. ruff check and ruff format --check are clean.
